name: yula
description: Evidence-bound SAP Public Edition objects, configuration and source maintenance in one offline SQLite corpus.

interface.shortDescription: SAP evidence, compact retrieval and controlled updates.
interface.longDescription: Three task-specific skills, four read-only MCP tools, a populated SQLite corpus and hash-bound online/local maintenance. Python 3.11+ with FTS5; no package installation required.
defaultPrompt: Find a released SAP object for my requirement.
Explain a configuration activity using evidence.
Check and update the Yula knowledge corpus.
